tipsAgain: You can see these tips again from Help.
tipBookingBody: When a customer books, this phone rings and the booking shows here on Today, in the barber's column. Every day at 8 am and 8 pm you also get a message with the bookings.
tipBookingBodyBarber: When a customer books you, this phone rings and the booking shows here in your column. At 8 am and 8 pm you also get a message with your bookings.
tipStartBody: When the customer comes, tap their booking, type the 4-digit code from their phone and tap {start}. No code? Tap {anyway}.
tipStartBodyBarber: When the customer comes, tap their booking, type the 4-digit code from their phone and tap {start}. No code? Ask the owner or the helper to start it.
tipWalkInTitle: A customer at the door without booking?
tipWalkInBody: Tap {walkIn}, tick what they want, pick a barber who shows {free} and start. Everyone busy? Keep a barber's free time for them. That time is then kept, so nobody books it online.
tipWalkInBodyBarber: If the owner lets you: tap {walkIn}, tick what they want and start. Busy? Keep your next free time for them.
tipChangeBody: Tap a booking: {doneEarly} frees the rest of its time, {noShow} when the customer didn't come, {giveTo} moves it to someone free.
tipChangeBodyBarber: Tap your booking: {doneEarly} frees the rest of its time, {noShow} when the customer didn't come. To give it to another barber, ask the owner or the helper.
tipBusyBody: Too many customers? Tap {pause}: customers can't book for a while. {addBreak} keeps customers off a barber's time.
tipBreakBodyBarber: Tap {addBreak} for a break of your own: today or tomorrow, up to 4 hours a day. For longer time off, ask the owner.
hintBookings: All bookings coming up, soonest first. Tap one to open it on the day board.
hintBookingsHistory: All bookings coming up, soonest first. Tap one to open it on the day board. {history} shows past days.
hintSalon: Everything customers see about your salon. Tap a row to change it.
hintSalonHelper: Your salon's services, hours and barbers. You can look; only the owner can change them.
hintServices: What customers can book, with prices. Tap {add} for a new one, or tap a service to change it.
hintServicesHelper: What customers can book, with prices. Only the owner can change them.
hintBarbers: Your barbers. Tap {add}, then open him to give his services, weekly hours and sign-in.
hintBarbersHelper: The salon's barbers and their hours. Only the owner can change them.
hintWalkIn: Tick what they want, then pick a barber: {free} starts at once; a busy barber's free time can be kept for the customer.
hintOffers: Discounts to fill quiet days. Tap {new}: your past customers get a message straight away.
hintOffersHelper: The owner's offers and the bookings they brought.
hintHours: The days and times your salon is open. Customers can book only inside them.
hintHoursHelper: The days and times your salon is open. Only the owner can change them.
tipWalkInBodyHelper: If the owner lets you: tap {walkIn}, tick what they want, pick a barber who shows {free} and start. Everyone busy? Keep a barber's free time for them.
tipLiveTitle: Customers near you can now book you
tipLiveBody: The first bookings can take a few days. Share your salon's link so your regular customers book here too.
tipLiveBodyBarber: Customers near the salon can now book you on their phone. Each booking shows here, in your column.
